senses.gloss: the lowest (worst) land of an estate (classified into עידית best, בינונית mean and ז׳).
units: <cite ref="Gittin 49a:4">Ib. 49ᵃ</cite> top <he>כגון … כז׳ דמזיק</he> when the claimant’s best land was only as good as the defendant’s worst.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 7b:19">B. Kam. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לו אלא … ז׳</he> if one has only third class land; a. fr.
